finalists.label: Dermatophytosis
finalists.why: It has the strongest for evidence, including mycological culture results and specific skin lesion descriptions.

finalists.label: Hypersensitivity reaction
finalists.why: It has relevant for evidence, including elevated IgE levels and eosinophils, without any against evidence.

finalists.label: Trichophytosis
finalists.why: Although it lacks specific for or against evidence, its relation to the mycological culture results makes it notable.

frontier_selector.why: The mycological culture yielding growth of Trichophyton mentagrophytes decisively supports Dermatophytosis over the other finalists.
